test_runs.selector: Hook event isolation, lifecycle, and relevant MCP integration bundle
negative_cases: Stop replay is exactly once and output-inert.
Missing/active kill switch, reentry, invalid schemas, and SessionEnd timeout fail closed.

test_runs.selector: Final hook isolation and lifecycle contract suite
negative_cases: The eight governed events remain ordered and the three unsupported events remain unclaimed.
Adapters remain transport-only and do not take over skill-owned behavior.
No release selector, fallback authority, or installation state changed.
Source-only hook additions do not relabel a channel or installed runtime.

test_runs.selector: Python lint, compile, PowerShell syntax, and whitespace validation
test_runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check hook sources/tests; py_compile; PowerShell AST parse; git diff --check
test_runs.output: All checks passed; Python sources compiled; POWERSHELL_AST_PASS; diff check returned zero
negative_cases: No live host hook, install receipt, hook SQLite, helper, tunnel, HIL, pointer, candidate, or Git action was invoked.
Only temporary pytest-owned hook control files were created.

limitations: Row207 implements source and isolated-test contracts only; live installation and activation are reserved for Row210.
Row208 must bind behavior handoff receipts to the skill-owned consumer before a hook may claim behavior completion.
Row209 retains final installed/package fixture unification for Stop first-delivery and stop_hook_active replay.
The three current upstream events outside this project's eight-event contract remain explicitly unsupported rather than silently added.
